protocol.signal: completed 4h close above macro SMA and positive trailing momentum; bearish state requires close below macro SMA and negative momentum
protocol.funding: bull exposure falls to 1x when last known funding exceeds 0.0001
protocol.effective_leverage_control: at every 15m open, reduce futures notional to 3x futures-wallet equity
protocol.selection: research and validation must beat aligned B&H under stress; maximize the weaker annualized excess, with drawdown reported rather than used as a gate
protocol.costs: base 5+2 bps; stress 10+5 bps per changed notional

limitations: No observations after 2026-09-02 UTC are included.
Annual returns are not guaranteed to exceed B&H in every year.
Intrabar leverage can exceed 3x between open controls during a fast price fall.
